Option Explicit
Function Item(r As Range) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant,s As String
v=r.Value
s=TypeName(v)
If IsDate(v) And VarType(v)=7 Then
s=s & ":" & CStr(CDbl(v)) & ":" & Format(v,"yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
Else
s=s & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
Item=s & ";raw=" & CStr(r.Value2) & ";text=" & r.Text & ";fmt=" & r.NumberFormat
Exit Function
Failed:
Item="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
s="mode=" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook.Date1904) & ";calculation=" & CStr(Application.Calculation)
For n=1 To 8
s=s & ";A" & n & "=[" & Item(ActiveSheet.Range("A" & n)) & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function PutCell(r As Range,v As Variant,raw As Boolean) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
If raw Then
r.Value2=v
Else
r.Value=v
End If
PutCell="OK:[" & Item(r) & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
PutCell="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Mode(v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveWorkbook.Date1904=v
Mode="OK:" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook.Date1904)
Exit Function
Failed:
Mode="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim result As String
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=False
Columns("A").ColumnWidth=35
ActiveWorkbook.Date1904=False
Range("A1:A8").NumberFormat="yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss"
Range("A1").Value2=0
Range("A2").Value2=1
Range("A3").Value2=59
Range("A4").Value2=60
Range("A5").Value2=61
Range("A6").Value2=-1
Range("A7").Value2=0.5
Range("A8").Value2=1462
result=Snapshot()
Probe=result
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

probes.name: two-books-isolation
probes.source:
Option Explicit
Function Item(r As Range) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant,s As String
v=r.Value
s=TypeName(v)
If IsDate(v) And VarType(v)=7 Then
s=s & ":" & CStr(CDbl(v)) & ":" & Format(v,"yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
Else
s=s & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
Item=s & ";raw=" & CStr(r.Value2) & ";text=" & r.Text & ";fmt=" & r.NumberFormat
Exit Function
Failed:
Item="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
s="mode=" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook.Date1904) & ";calculation=" & CStr(Application.Calculation)
For n=1 To 8
s=s & ";A" & n & "=[" & Item(ActiveSheet.Range("A" & n)) & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function PutCell(r As Range,v As Variant,raw As Boolean) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
If raw Then
r.Value2=v
Else
r.Value=v
End If
PutCell="OK:[" & Item(r) & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
PutCell="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Mode(v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ActiveWorkbook.Date1904=v
Mode="OK:" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook.Date1904)
Exit Function
Failed:
Mode="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim result As String
Application.EnableEvents=False
Application.Calculation=-4105
Application.CalculateBeforeSave=False
Columns("A").ColumnWidth=35
Dim first As Workbook,second As Workbook
Set first=ActiveWorkbook
first.Date1904=True
first.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Formula="=DATE(2024,2,29)"
Set second=Workbooks.Add
second.Date1904=False
second.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Formula="=DATE(2024,2,29)"
result="first=" & CStr(first.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value2) & ";second=" & CStr(second.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value2)
second.Close SaveChanges:=False
first.Activate
Probe=result
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
